name: Publish to Chromatic
description: Publish your Storybook to Chromatic and run visual regression tests

autoAcceptChanges.description: Automatically accept all changes in chromatic: boolean or branchname

buildScriptName.description: The npm script that builds your Storybook [build-storybook]

buildCommand.description: The command that builds your Storybook (when your build command does not exist in "scripts" of your package.json)

chromaticSha.description: The git SHA of the commit that should be tested in Chromatic. Defaults to the SHA of the current branch tip on which the action is running. Use with caution, as

configFile.description: Path from where to load the Chromatic config JSON file.

diagnosticsFile.description: Write process context information to a JSON file

dryRun.description: Run without actually publishing to Chromatic

exitOnceUploaded.description: Exit with 0 once the built version has been sent to chromatic: boolean or branchname

exitZeroOnChanges.description: Positive exit of action even when there are changes: boolean or branchname

externals.description: Disable TurboSnap when any of these files have changed since the baseline build

fileHashing.description: Whether to apply file hashing to skip uploading unchanged files (default: true)

forceRebuild.description: Do not skip build when a rebuild is detected

ignoreLastBuildOnBranch.description: Do not use the last build on this branch as a baseline if it is no longer in history (i.e. branch was rebased)

logFile.description: Write CLI logs to a file

logLevel.description: One of: silent, error, warn, info, debug (default: info)

logPrefix.description: Custom prefix for log messages (default: current timestamp)

onlyChanged.description: Enables TurboSnap: Only run stories affected by files changed since the baseline build

onlyStoryNames.description: Only run a single story or a subset of stories by their name

onlyStoryFiles.description: Only run a single story or a subset of stories by their filename(s)

outputDir.description: Relative path to target directory containing your Storybook (a temporary directory is used if this is not set)

preserveMissing.description: Deprecated, use onlyChanged, onlyStoryNames or onlyStoryFiles instead

projectToken.description: Your chromatic project token (best provided via env.CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN)

skip.description: Skip Chromatic tests, but mark the commit as passing

storybookBaseDir.description: Relative path from repository root to Storybook project root

storybookBuildDir.description: Provide a directory with your built storybook; use if you have already built your storybook

storybookConfigDir.description: Relative path from where you run Chromatic to your Storybook config directory

storybookLogFile.description: Write Storybook build logs to a file

traceChanged.description: Print dependency trace for changed files to affected story files; set to "expanded" to list individual modules

untraced.description: Disregard these files and their dependencies when tracing dependent stories for TurboSnap

uploadMetadata.description: Upload Chromatic metadata files as part of the published Storybook. Defaults to enabled when TurboSnap is requested.

workingDir.description: Working directory for the package.json file

zip.description: Publish your Storybook to Chromatic as a single zip file instead of individual content files

junitReport.description: Write build results to a JUnit XML file
